code review coverage (the proportion of changes that are code reviewed), code review participation (the degree of reviewer involvement), and code reviewer expertise (the level of domain-specific reviewer expertise) share a significant link to software quality.
code review coverage and participation are positively correlated with software quality, and code reviewer expertise is negatively correlated with software quality.
(1) code reviewers with more expertise and participation in code review tend to review more code, and (2) code reviewers with higher participation and expertise are more likely to identify defects.
